# WebP encoder

libwebp compiled to WebAssembly, used by `upload.html` to save `.webp` files in
browsers (such as Safari) that cannot encode WebP themselves.

Copied unmodified from the `codec/enc/` folder of
[@jsquash/webp](https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash) v1.5.0 (originally from
Google's Squoosh). Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`. libwebp is BSD licensed.
